body.message:
lease find the breakdown below:

12th May to 11th June – AED 6,600 (30 nights)
11th June to 11th July – AED 6,600 (30 nights)
11th July to 10th August – AED 6,600 (30 nights)
10th August to 9th September – AED 7,300 (30 nights)

If you wish to extend until 12th September, an additional 2 nights will be added at AED 486.66.

In total:
From 12th May until 12th September, the total stay will be 123 nights.

The total rate for 123 nights will be AED 27,586, and a refundable security deposit of AED 3,000 is also applicable.
